note: Run scripts/fetch-optional-assets.py explicitly. The script only downloads these fixed URLs and verifies SHA-256; it does not execute downloaded files or remote code, and it is not run by install.

required-for-B-audio.when: Required before producing B-mode videos that use the packaged audio library. Catalog, licenses and credits are already in the package.

required-for-B6-paint.when: Required for B6 paint-kit production that uses the default paint assets.

required-before-B8.role: Approved B8 default visual references and the portable replay pack
required-before-B8.when: Required before B8 planning and production; the user-approved exact reference versions define the default visual target.
